title: Shell dialect quoting rules
description: Module-level documentation on why quoting must happen in Rust.
body: Getting shell quoting wrong turns C:\Program Files\x into two arguments, which is the bug this feature exists to avoid. It lives in Rust rather than the frontend because only Rust knows which shell a session is talking to — the pty picked it from a setting and never told the emulator. The rule is adapted from Orca, using allow-lists rather than metacharacter lists: three dialects with different rules for PowerShell, Cmd, and POSIX shells.
